claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 26 July 1866, p. 2, col. 1 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 9 August 1866, p. 2, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tarifa (Br), Langlands, Liverpool July 24 and
Queenstown 25th, with mdse and 567[?] passengers, to E Cu-
nard. Aug 3, 11 AM, passed schr Billow Crest, bound E;
4th, 5:30 AM, passed ship Crescent City, from Liverpool for
Bath; 5th, 11 AM, passed steamship United Kingdom, hence
for Glasgow; 4:30 PM, passed a Inman steamer, also one of
Warren's line of steamers, both bound E.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 9 August 1866, p. 4, col. 3

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tarifa (Br.), Lawlands[?], Liverpool July 24, via Queens-
town 25th, with mdse. and 5[?]7 pass. to E. Cunard. July 25, off
Queenstown, passed steamship City of London, bound in; 26th, at
1:15 p. m., passed a National steamship, bound E; Aug. 3, at 11 a. m.,
passed schr. Billow Crest, bound E; 4th, at 5:30[?] a. m., passed ship[?]
Crescent City, bound W; 5th, at 11 a. m., passed steamship United
Kingdom, bound E; same day, at 4:30 p. m., passed an Inman steam-
ship, also one of Warren's line of steamers, both bound E.
